tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind every pane.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Lesson column, panels, cards, quiz options.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, inline command and code backgrounds, the visualizer's drawing board.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between panes, around cards, under tabs; the dots of the visualizer's grid.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button and input borders, sidenote rule, keycap edges. At least 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, sidenotes, quiz explanations, on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Metadata, step numbers, the 'next commit' ghost, on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button face, active tab underline, section heading bar, progress fill, focus ring.

tokens.name: primary-edge
tokens.usage: The 3px bottom edge of the primary keycap button.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighter behind key terms and the HEAD label. Always a background behind on-highlight text, never a text color.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight.

tokens.name: highlight-soft
tokens.usage: Soft marker stroke under key terms in lesson text (lower part of the line only), behind ink text. Calmer than highlight for long reading.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and Pro Git citations on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Mission-complete marks, correct-answer icon and border. Always paired with a check mark or a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Careful-note label and rule.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong-answer icon and border, destructive-command warnings. Always paired with a cross or a word.

tokens.name: git-working
tokens.usage: Working folder = a draft: the dashed outline of its zone and of modified files. Visualizer and lesson diagrams only.

tokens.name: git-staging
tokens.usage: Staging area = highlighted: the highlighter stripe on staged files and the area's swatch. Always behind dark text.

tokens.name: git-staging-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the staging zone.

tokens.name: git-staging-edge
tokens.usage: Outline of the staging zone and its label text; 4.5:1 or more on git-staging-wash.

tokens.name: git-repository
tokens.usage: Repository = inked: the solid zone, commit stations and history lines. Visualizer and lesson diagrams only.

tokens.name: on-git-repository
tokens.usage: Text and snapshot cards on git-repository.

tokens.name: git-branch
tokens.usage: Main history line and local branch labels.

tokens.name: git-branch-alt
tokens.usage: A second branch's history line (dashed) and its label.

tokens.name: git-remote
tokens.usage: Remote-tracking branch labels (origin/main), outlined and dashed.

tokens.name: terminal-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal screen. Dark in both themes, a hair warm like an old monitor.

tokens.name: terminal-chrome
tokens.usage: Terminal title bar and frame.

tokens.name: terminal-ink
tokens.usage: Normal terminal output on terminal-bg: warm phosphor white.

tokens.name: terminal-muted
tokens.usage: Prompt path, title bar text and dim output on terminal-bg and terminal-chrome.

tokens.name: terminal-prompt
tokens.usage: The prompt arrow and the cursor on terminal-bg.

tokens.name: terminal-glow
tokens.usage: Soft phosphor glow (text-shadow) on prompt and cursor only.

tokens.name: terminal-green
tokens.usage: Git's green output (staged files) on terminal-bg.

tokens.name: terminal-red
tokens.usage: Git's red output (unstaged files) on terminal-bg.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Lesson sections, with the primary bar on the left.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Git saves your work in two moves: you pick what to save, then you save it.
styles.usage: The one opening sentence of a lesson.

styles.name: lesson
styles.sample: Every file you touch sits in one of three places.
styles.usage: Lesson paragraphs and lists, max 64 characters wide.

styles.name: sidenote
styles.sample: Git has three main states that your files can reside in.
styles.usage: Pro Git quotes and margin notes.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Interface text, mission goals, quiz answers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: eyebrows, pane names, area names.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline commands (inline at 0.88em of the text around it).

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Commit IDs, branch labels, arrows in the visualizer, keycap letters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; small padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Note and quiz-option padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Lesson pane padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between lesson sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between major page areas; the visualizer grid pitch is space-4.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Home page sections.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Inline commands, badges, branch labels, keycap letters.

tokens.name: radius-medium
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, code blocks, quiz options.

tokens.name: radius-large
tokens.usage: The terminal window and the visualizer board.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Only menus, popovers and dialogs. Cards and panels stay flat.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The terminal window only, so it reads as a real device on the page.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and keycap press.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panels opening, tab changes.

tokens.name: duration-visual
tokens.usage: Visualizer moves (a file changing area, a new commit). Instant when reduce motion is on.
